## NET functions
# IPv4 addresses are 4 bytes in network byte order; a negative integer is its 32-bit two's
# complement.

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(0xABCDEF))
=> "00abcdef"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(0xFFFFFFFF))
=> "ffffffff"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-2))
=> "fffffffe"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-0x80000000))
=> "80000000"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(0x100000000)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-0x80000001)
=> null

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(b'\x00\x00\x01\xff')
=> "511"

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(b'\xff\xff\xff\xff')
=> "4294967295"

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-1))
=> "4294967295"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(b'\x01\x02\x03')
=> null

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_FROM_STRING('48.49.50.51'))
=> "30313233"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_FROM_STRING('::1'))
=> "00000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_FROM_STRING('::ffff:192.0.2.128'))
=> "00000000000000000000ffffc0000280"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_FROM_STRING('10.1.2.3/32')
=> null

SELECT NET.IP_FROM_STRING(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.SAFE_IP_FROM_STRING('48.49.50.51'))
=> "30313233"

SELECT NET.SAFE_IP_FROM_STRING('10.1.2.3/32')
=> null

SELECT NET.IP_TO_STRING(b'0123')
=> "48.49.50.51"

SELECT NET.IP_TO_STRING(b'0123456789@ABCDE')
=> "3031:3233:3435:3637:3839:4041:4243:4445"

SELECT NET.IP_TO_STRING(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\xff\xff\xc0\x00\x02\x80')
=> "::ffff:192.0.2.128"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_TO_STRING(b'\x01\x02\x03')
=> null

SELECT NET.IP_TO_STRING(CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_NET_MASK(4, 0))
=> "00000000"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_NET_MASK(4, 20))
=> "fffff000"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_NET_MASK(16, 1))
=> "80000000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_NET_MASK(16, 128))
=> "ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_NET_MASK(8, 0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_NET_MASK(4, 33)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_NET_MASK(4, -1)
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_TRUNC(b'\xAA\xBB\xCC\xDD', 11))
=> "aaa00000"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_TRUNC(b'\xAA\xBB\xCC\xDD', 12))
=> "aab00000"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IP_TRUNC(b'0123456789@ABCDE', 80))
=> "30313233343536373839000000000000"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_TRUNC(b'\xAA\xBB\xCC\xDD', 33)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.NET.IP_TRUNC(b'\xAA\xBB\xCC', 0)
=> null

## Hosts and domains of URLs

SELECT NET.HOST('')
=> null

SELECT NET.HOST('http://abc.xyz')
=> "abc.xyz"

SELECT NET.PUBLIC_SUFFIX('http://abc.xyz')
=> "xyz"

SELECT NET.REG_DOMAIN('http://abc.xyz')
=> "abc.xyz"

SELECT NET.HOST('//user:password@a.b:80/path?query')
=> "a.b"

SELECT NET.PUBLIC_SUFFIX('//user:password@a.b:80/path?query')
=> null

SELECT NET.REG_DOMAIN('//user:password@a.b:80/path?query')
=> null

SELECT NET.HOST('https://[::1]:80')
=> "[::1]"

SELECT NET.HOST('http://例子.卷筒纸.中国')
=> "例子.卷筒纸.中国"

SELECT NET.PUBLIC_SUFFIX('http://例子.卷筒纸.中国')
=> "中国"

SELECT NET.REG_DOMAIN('http://例子.卷筒纸.中国')
=> "卷筒纸.中国"

SELECT NET.HOST('    www.Example.Co.UK    ')
=> "www.Example.Co.UK"

SELECT NET.PUBLIC_SUFFIX('    www.Example.Co.UK    ')
=> "Co.UK"

SELECT NET.REG_DOMAIN('    www.Example.Co.UK    ')
=> "Example.Co.UK"

SELECT NET.HOST('mailto:?to=&subject=&body=')
=> "mailto"

SELECT NET.REG_DOMAIN('mailto:?to=&subject=&body=')
=> null

SELECT NET.HOST(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null
